ackLabel.message: I have reviewed all warnings and cross-check results

appDescription.message: A local audit tool that logs typing, pasting, and submissions in the browser — metadata only by default; on allowlisted sites it also records values, edit history, and submit-time snapshots. On allowlisted sites it also provides a pre-submit check (a review list with confirmation before sending), L1 rule checks (warnings for empty fields, full-width characters, paste anomalies, and more), L2 source data cross-check (against source data imported in the side panel), and restore assist.

clearConfirm.message: Delete all $N$ log entries? This cannot be undone.

collationStats.message: Cross-checked $COVERED$/$TOTAL$ fields (coverage $PCT$%) · matched $MATCHED$ · mismatched $MISMATCHED$ · suspected swaps $SWAPS$

gateNote.message: This is the list of input values about to be submitted. Review the contents before sending. (Warnings point out signs of a possible problem; they do not judge whether a value is correct. The final decision is yours.)

popupNote.message: Values are saved only on sites added to “Sites that record values” above. Everywhere else, only character counts and entry types are recorded. Password fields are always excluded. Everything is stored on this device only. On sites that record values, the pre-submit check lists all inputs just before submission and blocks sending until you confirm (confirmations and cancellations are also logged). In the side panel you can import source data and cross-check your inputs against it at the pre-submit check.

restoreText.message: $N$ entries from a previous input session remain

spAutoMatchDone.message: A mapping was created automatically. Review it, then press “Save mapping”.

spAutoMatchNoTarget.message: No target tab was found, so automatic matching was skipped. Use the button below to match.

spClearSource.message: Delete source data for this host

spClipboardFail.message: Could not read the clipboard. Please paste into the text box.

spImportNoHost.message: Not saved, because there is no target tab

spImportOverwritten.message: $N$ duplicate items were overwritten with the newer values

spInputPlaceholder.message:
Paste a table of “item … value” rows (tab-, comma-, or space-separated). The last column of each row is read as the value; the rest becomes the item key.
Example:
Glucose Sample 1	92
Glucose Sample 2	148

spMatch.message: Match with the fields in this tab

spNoFields.message: Could not get the input fields. Open the input screen in the target tab, then press the button again.

spNoSource.message: No source data has been imported yet.

spNote.message: Import the source data (the reference table of item → value) for the target host and save how it maps to the input fields. Source data and mappings are stored only on this device and are never sent to the site. Your inputs are cross-checked against the source data at the pre-submit check.

spSkippedLines.message: Lines that could not be read ($N$)

warnDuplicate.message: The same value “$VALUE$” appears in $COUNT$ fields. Check for swapped entries or copy mistakes.

warnFullwidth.message: Contains full-width characters. If this is meant to be a number, re-enter it using half-width characters.

warnPasteConverted.message: The pasted content was converted (e.g. full-width to half-width).

warnPasteLeadingZero.message: The leading 0 of the pasted content has been dropped.

warnPasteMultiline.message: This was pasted from multiple lines or cells. Check that values belonging to other items are not mixed in.

warnPasteTruncated.message: The pasted content ($PLEN$ characters) does not match the field value ($VLEN$ characters). It may have been truncated or rewritten.

warnUnit.message: The value includes the unit “$UNIT$”. Enter the number only.

warnWhitespace.message: Contains line breaks, tabs, or leading/trailing spaces.
